newsAndUpdates.headline: MHPU Raises Concerns Over Healthcare Professionals Being Reclassified as Non-Professionals
MHPU submit official letters to Ministry of Health and Ministry of Homeland Regarding the Concerns Over Healthcare Professionals Being Reclassified as Non-Professionals

pressReleases.title: UPDATE: EXPATRIATE HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONALS’ OCCUPATION CATEGORIZATION CORRECTED
pressReleases.summary: MHPU’s advocacy and campaign has led to the correction of the occupation categorization of affected expatriate healthcare workers in the Xpat Portal.

pressReleases.title: Tribunal Overturns Unlawful Disciplinary Action Against MHPU Member, Affirming Workers’ Right to Organize
pressReleases.summary:
The Employment Tribunal has declared the disciplinary action taken against an MHPU member null and void, ruling that it violated the Employment Act.

The case involved a staff member who created a Viber group for colleagues to discuss workplace concerns and unionization efforts.
